name: Holy Aura
targets: one creature/level in a 20-ft.-radius burst centered on you
summary: Ward allies with +4 defenses, spell resistance 25 against evil, and protection from possession and mental control.
description: Each warded creature gains a +4 deflection bonus to AC, a +4 resistance bonus on saves, spell resistance 25 against evil spells and spells cast by evil creatures, and protection from possession and mental influence. An evil creature that succeeds at a melee attack against a warded creature must succeed at a Fortitude save or be blinded permanently.
